title: Don't Trouble the Trouble
plot_overview: A magician accidentally makes a young girl vanish with a spell. The girl explores the city, where her unusual powers create trouble when she becomes angry, setting off a magical adventure involving wishes and unexpected consequences.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like magical adventures centered on wishes and unexpected powers; Not for you if you prefer grounded stories or detailed character drama.
review_summary: Pros: magical premise; city adventure; wish-granting intrigue | Cons: limited story detail; no review consensus
